newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan awards 3Q diesel, mogas, delays fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan awards 3Q diesel, mogas, delays fuel oil.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources has awarded its July-September import for motor and aviation gasoline and gas oil but has extended the validity on the fuel or furnace oil offers, an industry source said on Wednesday.
The tender for the third quarter closed May 31 and was valid until June 10.
"The ministry has extended the validity until June 17," the source said. "The demand and supply situation is being assessed as the imports solely depend on the monsoon."

Pakistan had already reduced the volume of 180-cst, 3.5-percent and 1.0-percent sulphur furnace oil in its third quarter tender from its second quarter purchases due to the monsoon season when fuel-power is displaced by hydropower.
For the third quarter, Pakistan is seeking a total of 170,000 tonnes of fuel oil and another 170,000 tonnes as an option, compared to the 700,000 tonnes purchased for the second quarter.
Gas oil requirements for the third quarter were also smaller due to a lull in agricultural activites.

For the third quarter, Pakistan purchased 180,000-tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil from Saudi-based Xenium Overseas, with an option to buy 120,000 tonnes from U.K.-based trader Hascombe and Mideast trader Star Energy.
In comparison, Pakistan's second quarter 1.0-percent gas oil purchases totalled 450,000 tonnes at 84 cents to $1.14 per barrel over Mideast quotes, cost-and-freight Keamari.
Pakistan bought one motor gasoline cargo for July at around $25 per tonne over Mideast naphtha quotes, c+f Pakistan -- almost on par with its last purchase of two cargoes in May at a $25.43 premium.
But its optional purchase for September delivery was much firmer at a premium of around $29.00.
The details for the third quarter tender and the awards are as follows: (in tonnes)
Aviation Gasoline 1,200 July Vitol, mean Med (premium
Gasoline 80-oct 25,000 July Star Energy, mean Mideast
Furnace oil 3.5 pct c+f Fotco VALIDITY EXTENDED-JUN 17
Furnace oil 1.0 pct c+f Keamari VALIDITY EXTENDED -JUN 17
